matriarchy

例句：The working class, which has long defined our notions of masculinity, is slowly turning into a matriarchy, with men increasingly absent from the home and women making all the decisions.
长期以来，被我们认定为阳刚之气代名词的工人阶级，正慢慢转向母权制，男性在家庭中作用正逐渐消失，由女性做所有决定。
